details: Contributed to the re-orchestration of Amazon Translation Management Service, transitioning from a monolithic architecture to microservices
Integrated the system into a fully-native AWS environment by rewriting the pipelines

Participated in complete software development lifecycle for six projects as a contractor and built high-performance device status products catering for over 3,000 developers, contributing to the system scalability and maintainability and successful delivery of key functionalities

Created essential features, modules, and auxiliary applications utilizing Java, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Oracle SQL, and Cassandra with effective containerization through Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD via GitLab pipelines
Maintained and optimized systems with tens of thousands of requests per minute, resolving more than 50 performance bottlenecks and enhancing system stability and performance by 35%
Collaborated with over 40 upstream and downstream stakeholders to achieve seamless integration, utilizing RESTful APIs, SOAP, Ldap search, resulting in a 25% reduction in integration issues
Facilitated over 100 code reviews and troubleshooting sessions within an Agile framework, elevating the technical proficiency of the entire team by 20%
Conducted regular technical knowledge transfer sessions and authored detailed technical documentation, ensuring projects’ maintainability and scalability

Participated in the complete SDLC of a microservice message-driven application with Angular TypeScript and Java Spring Boot framework, featuring facilitating user interaction, content sharing, and community building

Implemented efficiently manage high-concurrency conditions by utilizing non-blocking Reactor and asynchronous processing RabbitMQ, enabling the application to remain scalable, resilient, and responsive even during traffic spikes

Architected and implemented the Gateway pattern, load balancing, and dynamic scaling with Eureka and Feign, facilitating request customization while ensuring fault tolerance and enhancing service resilience
Strengthened data security by implementing OAuth2.0 w/ JWT in conjunction with Spring Security
Oversaw the application state utilizing NgRx and optimized application for modular architecture with dependency injection
Ensured data management system by utilizing AWS RDS for relational data and MongoDB for document-structured data
Conducted unit test, load testing with JUnit, Mockito, JaCoCo, JMeter, maintained superior code quality through SonarQube and implemented automating CI/CD pipelines through Jenkins
Led the design and development of a React Single Page Application (SPA) for the Interactive English Web Courseware, utilizing React, Redux, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and RESTful APIs
Architected and implemented a highly interactive and user-friendly frontend interface, enhancing student engagement

Collaborated with educational content creators to seamlessly integrate curriculum-specific materials into the courseware and conducted regular code reviews to foster a collaborative and high-performing team environment
Integrated multimedia content, videos and interactive exercises, to create an immersive and effective learning experience
Conducted user testing and feedback sessions, continuously improving the courseware based on student and teacher input

Achieved a 30% increase in student engagement and a 25% increase in course completion rates compared to traditional methods, benefiting over 3,000 students and 20 teachers, and contributing to the organization’s educational mission
Taught over 100 students L-S-R-W skills in English and was awarded as presenter of *the city-wide Most Popular English Class*
Designed, strategized and supervised student academic enrichment programs on a school-wide scale, catering to a large audience of over 2,400 attendees
Provided mentoring to students on implementation and troubleshooting by leveraging a strong comprehension of web development frameworks and server-side technologies

Performed weekly Github code reviews of student assignments, thoroughly evaluated the code for issues, and provided optimal bug solutions and explanations that incorporated relevant web development notions
Ensured consistent and clear communication with students by promptly responding to emails and holding regular office hours for providing additional support outside class hours
Demonstrated knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, and advised on best practices for web design, including responsive layout creation and accessibility implementation
Collaborated with team partner to assess weekly student Github assignments by analyzing code functionality, identifying issues and suggesting improvements or solutions
Held office hours to provide guidance on efficient collaboration using Git, while assisting students in resolving any conflicts that may arise during the collaboration process

Exhibited proficiency in conveying intricate concepts related to C++ and OOP, such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism, to students with diverse levels of prior experience, resulting in effective communication
Teamed up with a teaching assistant partner to ensure effective delivery of course material and consistent and fair grading standards
Deliverd empathetic feedback to students on their code work with a focus on helping them improve their comprehension of C++ syntax and object-oriented programming concepts
